kind: loop 8 summary (full-run data pipeline and training stage prepared; no training run)
device: CPU-only preparation (Apple M5 MacBook Pro, py3.11.15 .venv-stage1); no training run in this loop

s2_archive.complete: both parts present with sizes equal to the HF tree lfs_size; these are the only S2 parts in that tree, so the set is complete
s2_archive.sha256_note: recording the recorded lfs_sha256 values is not the same as verifying them; a full 63.5 GB re-hash was not run in this loop
s2_archive.missing: nothing required for a 12-band train shard build
s2_archive.extraction: not performed: the extracted set is roughly 0.5 TB against 80 GiB free, so the builder streams instead

inventory.disk_buffer_rule: builds refuse to start unless free - projected_bytes >= 40 GiB

measured_band_geometry.method: read-only decodes of the first 400 S2 archive members plus a diagnostic build of 8 selected patches; no pixels were written by the diagnostics
measured_band_geometry.significance: BigEarthNet V2 stores each band at its own GSD; this is why the frozen contract upsamples to 120x120 and why loop 3 saw coarse 60 m texture in B01/B09. The first attempt of this loop mis-grouped B08 and was corrected by measurement, recorded in the preregistration as amendment 2.

shard_build.artifact: data/shards/train-2000 (ignored by git; manifest and sidecars travel, pixels do not)
shard_build.attempt: attempt 1 of the corrected problem after two recorded failures
shard_build.loader_check_summary: five real shard rows resample and normalize to finite float32 (12,120,120) tensors; 0.064 s for five samples end to end on CPU

projections.method: linear from the measured 2000-patch shard; a projection, not a measurement

shard_build.n_is_a_parameter: the projections exceed the pre-registered 30 GB default session budget above N=150k and exceed the local 40 GiB buffer rule at N=422,809, so N must be chosen after the Kaggle session disk is measured; the builder enforces the budget and refuses rather than truncating

published_manifests.why: shard pixels are derived data and are gitignored; these manifests are the traveling integrity record, and rebuilding at the recorded seed reproduces the per-shard SHA256

eval_shard.purpose: held-out caption-loss shard consumed by --eval-shards; built from the 6 eval tiles only

purity_measured.assertion: assert_split_purity(selected, rows, 'train') runs in scripts/build_stage1_shards.py before build_shards and raises on any eval ID, duplicate, or unknown patch; data/test_bigearthnet_shards.py::test_split_purity_rejects_eval_and_duplicates asserts all three

no_eval_pixels_in_train_shards.evidence: the built train shard holds 2,000 distinct patches, 0 eval-side patch IDs, tiles disjoint from the 6 eval tiles, every patch geo_split == 'train' in the frozen split manifest; archive members from eval tiles were streamed past and never decoded into a shard

features: per-epoch permutation derived only from (seed, epoch); the checkpoint stores (epoch, cursor)
checkpoint every 500 optimizer steps: model, optimizer, scheduler, data position, RNG state, config identity
wall-clock guard at 39600 s by default: final checkpoint plus results JSON, clean exit, status wall_clock_guard_exit
resumable hash chain over (step, patch_id) proving the sample sequence survived the kill
caption-only eval loss every 2000 steps on an eval-tile shard, no optimizer updates
config identity ignores session-scoped keys so a new session may change max_steps_per_session or the guard
train_stage.no_quality_gate: a full run records measurements only

gate_eval_protocol.recommended: Option A: place the available bands in their true Sentinel-2 slots (RGB -> B04/B03/B02) and fill the remaining slots with the frozen per-band training mean so standardization yields exactly 0; resample 256x256 -> 120x120 with rasterio bilinear before the contract; use the identical path for Stage-0 and Stage-1

rejected_alternatives.zero_fill_raw_dn: filling raw DN with 0 clips to the contract floor after standardization, which is not the mean
rejected_alternatives.band_duplication: fabricates spectral signal the model was trained to read
rejected_alternatives.slice_the_patch_embed_back_to_3: discards the adaptation the stage exists to install

unverified_locally: RSVQA-LR band count, dtype, DN scale, and geographic extent (data/raw/rsvqa_lr is absent and nothing was downloaded)
gate runtime (greedy generation over 10,004 questions) is UNKNOWN, not assumed
gate_eval_protocol.region_fact: BigEarthNet train tiles cover 9 European countries and eval tiles cover Austria, Ireland, Lithuania, Serbia (+Kosovo); the split is MGRS-blocked, not country-blocked, so four countries appear on both sides

tests.full_suite: 469 passed, 0 failed, exit 0 (441 after loop 7, +28 new)

acceptance rules for off-size and raw-zero candidates

resume exactness of the sample sequence and of the losses

bugs_found_and_fixed_during_this_loop: candidate-order row filling would have needed an unbounded buffer and would have destroyed the seeded tile stratification; replaced by the loop-4 pattern of selecting the stratified set first
a running SHA256 cannot be continued from its own hex digest; replaced with a resumable hash chain
the acceptance rule used a single 120x120 size for all bands, which rejected every real patch
B08 was initially grouped with the 20 m bands; corrected to 10 m after a measured rejection
the per-sample resample path was added to the frozen loader as resample_band, and the existing loader tests still pass unchanged
scripts/run_stage1_full.py could not be executed as a script (no repository root on sys.path); fixed and now covered by test_cli_entry_points_run_from_the_repository_root
not_done_by_design: no Kaggle upload, no T4 session, no training run, no throughput or memory measurement
no archive extraction and no download
the full-train shard set is not built; N is a parameter pending a measured session disk budget
open_issues: T4 throughput is still unmeasured, so config-full.yaml ships placeholder steps and the wall-clock guard is the only bound reasoned about, not measured
the S2 archive parts were not re-hashed; only their sizes were checked against the HF tree
the per-sample rasterio resample costs about 13 ms on CPU; it has not been timed inside a T4 step
RSVQA-LR band count, scale, extent, and gate runtime remain unverified locally
the rejected-by-rule fraction is 0 on 2,000 train and 2,000 eval patches but is not established for a larger build
